plain: Seeming to be arranged by divine care

webster.text: Effected by the providence of God; referable to divine providence; proceeding from divine direction or superintendence; as the providential contrivance of things; a providential escape from danger.

example.quote: Every step by which they have advanced to the character of an independent nation seems to have been distinguished by some token of providential agency;
example.cite: George Washington, First Inaugural Address, Apr. 30, 1789
